description: T-VEHICLES-002 ordinary-client campaign smoke: launch the typed catalog mission base:escape, use --debug-mount-bike only as a bootstrap candidate invocation, and wait for the production vehicle_driver_ready facts before exercising acceleration, braking, steering, look, handbrake, dismount, and one ordinary ACTION_VEHICLE_USE remount. The debug bootstrap does not prove the normal propFindForInteract line-of-sight or collision path; the second mount is the ordinary interaction witness. The directional dismount/facing choice can leave Player 0 outside the ordinary remount range/facing aperture, so deterministic remount failure remains an explicit risk rather than a hidden reposition. No listen-authority/two-client or V-009 proof is claimed.

input_sequence.comment: Readiness-relative bootstrap barrier: the offline non-title stage, local Player 0, gameplay layer, normal tick, and walking control must be live before the armed debug candidate is allowed to consume. The bounded skip assist advances a live campaign intro through the production cutscene aperture.

Causal mounted readiness barrier: the current non-title stage-ready Player 0 must be alive, controllable, unpaused, in normal gameplay, mounted with a hoverbike, and driving through LAYER_VEHICLE_DRIVER.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_ACCELERATE
input_sequence.comment: Mounted acceleration reaches the production vehicle movement path.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_STEER_RIGHT
input_sequence.comment: Mounted steering is consumed by the vehicle input path.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_HANDBRAKE
input_sequence.comment: Handbrake-only input enters the mounted vehicle path.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_BRAKE
input_sequence.comment: Release brake before the dismount transaction.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_EXIT
input_sequence.comment: Production dismount and vehicle-driver input-layer teardown.
Causal post-dismount barrier: Player 0 must be back in ordinary offline gameplay before the normal interaction remount.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_USE
input_sequence.comment: Exactly one ordinary on-foot vehicle-use remount through propFindForInteract LOS/collision selection; this is the second and real interaction mount witness, not bootstrap.
Scripted exit; lifecycle verdict requires both mount receipts, causal readiness, mounted input, dismount, and the ordinary remount witness.
